Treatment-page schema uses the wrong office pin

Dentist schema on 28 treatment pages places the office about 5.6 km from its verified GBP pin, alongside related entity and doctor-photo errors.

  • Set shared Dentist.geo to 37.3698774, -77.5016752; use one stable practice ID and refresh the supported review count from 97 to 151.
  • Restrict Service markup to treatment pages, give it distinct IDs, and fix doctor IDs/photo references; keep correct phone, address and hours.
02

Desktop selects a very large animation

The desktop hero selects a 43.7 MB animated WebP, while a separate 34.9 MB image is preloaded but unused in both captured layouts.

  • Replace #image-44-11’s animated source with a quality-preserving video or lightweight poster, keeping the intended experience.
  • Remove the unused hero-commonwealth.webp preload and the erroneous fonts.gstatic.com/ stylesheet preload; retain needed font styles.
03

All-on-X needs a focused full-arch explanation

The All-on-X page mainly repeats general implant definitions and a single-post process instead of explaining its full-arch pathway.

  • Revise this page around the practice’s actual full-arch options, stages, maintenance and fee questions; keep general implant content on its own page.
  • Review the current evidence against the previously completed All-on-X content task before assigning further work.
04

The footer uses a different street name

The visible footer says 10601 Greenyard Way, while the exact GBP and business schema use 10601 Greenyard Rd.

  • Change the shared footer street from Greenyard Way to Greenyard Rd, matching the GBP; keep Chester, VA 23831.

Fix order

Correct shared business data and heavy homepage assets, then refine the specialized service copy.

  • Website + SEO: one schema correction package, the footer address and precise image/preload cleanup.
  • Content: review the All-on-X page; keep unconfirmed insurance and membership plans on their existing hold.
